"""Collect pages from fetch(cursor) returning items and next_cursor."""
def collect(fetch):
    cursor = None
    items = []
    seen = set()
    while True:
        if cursor in seen:
            raise ValueError("repeated pagination cursor")
        seen.add(cursor)
        page = fetch(cursor)
        rows = page["items"]
        if not rows:
            return items
        items.extend(rows)
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items
